'''NK Travnik''' ({{langx|bs|Nogometni Klub Travnik}}), commonly known as '''Travnik''' is a professional [[association football]] club from the city of [[Travnik]] that is situated in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

Currently, Travnik plays in the [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and plays its home matches on [[Stadion Pirota]] which has a capacity of 3,076 seats."}}
